first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: A yellow low-slung sports car in the foreground, with a dark rear panel, a large red rear wing, and four red ring-shaped taillights.

entities.name: Vehicle B
entities.identification: A white low-slung sports car ahead of Vehicle A, identifiable by its white rear, dark rear area, and red taillight points.

entities.name: racetrack surface
entities.identification: The gray paved surface extending from the bottom edge of the image to the bend ahead.

entities.name: sky
entities.identification: The low-texture blue-gray sky above the mountain and trees.

entities.name: exhaust flame
entities.identification: The blue-orange flame briefly emitted from the tailpipe opening on the image-left side of Vehicle A.

entities.name: red-and-white curb
entities.identification: The alternating red-and-white curb arranged along the image-left boundary of the racetrack.

entities.name: green runoff area
entities.identification: The narrow green paved strip outside the red-and-white curb ahead on the left.

entities.name: concrete racetrack barrier
entities.identification: The continuous low gray wall on the left and the distant barrier, with some visible surfaces colored white and blue or alternating red and white.

entities.name: metal racetrack guardrail
entities.identification: The gray-blue guardrail extending along the roadside on the right, with parallel horizontal panels.

entities.name: racetrack safety fence
entities.identification: The gray mesh fence supported by repeated tall posts atop the wall and along the distant roadside.

entities.name: trees around the outside of the racetrack
entities.identification: Dense dark-green trees around the hillside and roadside perimeter, with crowns of varying heights.

entities.name: distant mountain
entities.identification: The undulating gray-green distant mountain beneath the sky, with some lighter areas on its face.

entities.name: racetrack grandstand
entities.identification: The gray grandstand beside the track, with horizontal seating and stepped contours.

entities.name: racetrack sign
entities.identification: The white arrow-shaped distance signs on the left side of the racetrack and the light-colored rectangular billboard on the right.

entities.name: roadside grass
entities.identification: The low green ground cover between the curb and wall on the left and outside the barrier facilities on the right.

entities.name: tall slender pole beside the racetrack
entities.identification: The slender red-gray structure extending diagonally from the distant roadside toward the sky, retaining the source entity name.

entities.name: group of spectators in the grandstand
entities.identification: Rows of small human figures in the grandstand, with clothing of varying lightness and darkness.

entities.name: group of people in orange beside the entrance to the right-hand bend
entities.identification: Multiple people in orange to the left of the entrance to the right-hand bend, behind the safety fence in front of the grandstand.
